title: mentha japonica
intro: Mentha japonica, commonly known as Japanese mint, is a species of mint native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion and alleviate symptoms of nausea and indigestion. The therapeutic actions of Japanese mint include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Japanese mint include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as menthone and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
